title: Cancel after picking a category puts the Categories line back
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 50, pricing a new category made for this test, category A.
  • Have a new category for this test, category B, priced by a new matrix made for this test, matrix B, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, left on Default for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Pick category B in the Categories picker.
  5. Close the picker.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. Click Discard Changes.
  8. Open work order 1.
  9. Click Add Part under line 1.
  10. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  11. Type 1 in Qty.
  12. Pick category B in Category.
  13. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  14. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens in view, its Categories line naming category A.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit, with Cancel and Save.

Step 4:

  • Category B was listed with "Now:" and matrix B's name, and is now ticked.

Step 5:

  • The Categories line names category A and category B.

Step 6:

  • A question "Discard these changes?" opens with Keep Editing and Discard Changes.

Step 7:

  • The grid returns to view.
  • The Categories line names category A, as before, without category B.

Step 8:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 9:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 10:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 11:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 12:

  • Category shows category B.

Step 13:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 14:

  • The part's sell price fills in as $120.00, matrix B's price ($100.00 × 1.20 = $120.00), not matrix A's $150.00.
